acceptanceCriteria: Agent Trace records present in the repository are read into bounded repository-history rows with foreign text confined to the untrusted member.
A fixture covers a trace whose ranges overlap CEM hunks.
No URL in a trace is fetched.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). internal/gitnotes reads the git-ai `refs/notes/ai` authorship log and Assisted-by trailers (FPK-V0-037..040). Agent Trace, the Cursor RFC backed by Cognition, Cloudflare, Vercel, git-ai, Amp and OpenCode (agent-trace.dev), is the storage-agnostic attribution record with line ranges and contributor type, and is not read. V1-0307 only notes its absence from the competitive framing. Reading it, bounded and untrusted, lets V1-0408 order review by AI-authored hunks from either carrier.
title: provenance: read Agent Trace records beside git-ai notes as untrusted repository-history rows
